nodes.description: The favicon's role: the browser-tab icon served from the site root as public/favicon.svg.

nodes.label: Corgi Photo (corgi.jpg)
nodes.rationale: JPEG photograph, 2400x1600, of a Pembroke Welsh Corgi sitting on a light stone ledge, mouth open with tongue out, facing the camera. Background is a warm rust-orange metal panel wall with blurred cherry blossom branches overhead. No embedded text, logos, or watermarks. Stock-photo styling and its location in public/images indicate a demo/sample static asset.
nodes.description: Static demo photograph of a Pembroke Welsh Corgi served from public/images, used to demonstrate static asset serving.

nodes.label: Pembroke Welsh Corgi (subject)
nodes.rationale: The primary depicted subject: a fluffy tan-and-white corgi in a seated pose.
nodes.description: The dog depicted in the public/images corgi photograph: a tan-and-white Pembroke Welsh Corgi in a seated pose.

nodes.label: Demo Static Image Asset
nodes.rationale: Likely role in the project: a sample image served from public/ to demonstrate static asset serving and image optimization in the starter template.
nodes.description: The role the corgi photo plays in the project: a sample image demonstrating static asset serving and image optimization.

nodes.label: public/images directory
nodes.rationale: Containing directory of the asset, served as static files at /images/.
nodes.description: The public/images directory, whose contents Astro serves verbatim under the /images/ URL prefix.

nodes.label: Noise Texture Image (noise.png)
nodes.rationale: A small, seamless-looking grayscale image consisting of fine, sparse dark speckles scattered on a white/near-white field - a classic film-grain / noise tile. It depicts no subject matter; it is a purely procedural-looking texture.
nodes.description: A small grayscale tile of sparse dark speckles on a near-white field — a film-grain noise texture with no subject matter.

nodes.label: Grain Overlay Background Texture
nodes.rationale: Inferred role: served as a static public asset and tiled/overlaid via CSS background-image to add subtle grain to page backgrounds. Its uniform speckle pattern and placement in public/images are consistent with decorative use rather than content.
nodes.description: The role noise.png plays: a tiled CSS background texture adding subtle grain to page backgrounds.

nodes.label: public/images Static Asset
nodes.rationale: File lives under the project's public/images directory, so it is served verbatim at /images/noise.png by the Astro static asset pipeline.
nodes.description: noise.png as served from public/images, delivered verbatim at /images/noise.png by Astro's static asset pipeline.

nodes.label: Corgi Photo (src/assets)
nodes.rationale: Photograph of a fluffy Pembroke Welsh Corgi sitting on a pale stone ledge, tongue out, facing the camera, against a rust-orange metal panel wall with cherry blossom branches overhead. Located in src/assets/ so it is imported and processed by the Astro image pipeline (optimization, responsive srcset) rather than served statically; typical demo/sample asset for an Astro starter template.
nodes.description: The same corgi photograph placed in src/assets so Astro's build-time image pipeline optimizes it rather than serving it verbatim.

nodes.label: Astro Image Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Astro's built-in asset processing for files under src/assets/, which optimizes and emits hashed image variants at build time.
nodes.description: Astro's build-time asset processing for files under src/assets, which optimizes images and emits hashed variants.

nodes.label: Pembroke Welsh Corgi (Dog Subject)
nodes.rationale: Visual subject of the photograph: a tan-and-white fluffy corgi.
nodes.description: The dog depicted in the src/assets corgi photograph: a tan-and-white Pembroke Welsh Corgi.
